subject._note: School of Sport container context: one academic school spanning sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength & conditioning. No QAA subject benchmark for sport in this repo, so prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark file.

_note: School of Sport container pack for starting-progressing-succeeding-intermediate. Frames the academic-practice skill (mindset, motivation and goals in action) for the whole school, drawing worked examples from different sport subjects lesson to lesson (L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching, L03 sport therapy and rehabilitation).
